trigger: a genuinely new economic descriptor is proposed before a future alpha assertion enters alpha_assertion
preconditions: the new descriptor list and formulas are declared and hashed before execution
the list contains no descriptor previously tested against the same risk basis
the statistical subspace and L1 manifests carry the same current risk_basis_id and risk_metric_id, and all frozen semantic descriptors are rerun together on a new basis
semantic_probe_decision_count increments in the separate semantic_probe_ledger; exposure-only probes do not enter the return-hypothesis BH denominator
forbidden: rerun a previously tested descriptor against the same basis
change J and rerun only the descriptors whose earlier overlap was inconvenient
add, remove, transform, or proxy descriptors after seeing overlap results
analyst_coverage_unlock: historical PIT coverage observations include source availability timestamps, the source is registered and hashed, and the full formula is declared before the reentry event
theme_proxy_unlock: the proxy is PIT-computable, registered as a new descriptor before any alpha result, and satisfies the same hash and variant-cost rules

multiplicity_boundary.bh_exclusion_rationale: The probe assertion concerns omitted semantic structure in risk exposures, not whether any factor predicts returns.
